blocks.orig: Climbing Kilimanjaro via the popular 6-day Machame Route
blocks.html: Summit Kilimanjaro on the popular 6-day Machame Route

blocks.orig: The Machame route was voted as the most beautiful climbing route in the world! This is due to the stunning views of Mount Meru, the impressive ascent along the Barranco wall and other highlights you see. The route also has well-maintained hiking trails. You can also see more of Kilimanjaro, because the Machame route takes a different route to the summit than for the descent.
blocks.html: The Machame route was once voted the most beautiful climbing route in the world! Credit goes to the wonderful views of Mount Meru, the striking climb up the Barranco wall and the other highlights along the way. The trails on this route are also well kept. On top of that, you get to see more of Kilimanjaro, since the Machame route uses one path to reach the summit and another to come down.

blocks.orig: The ascent via the Machame route takes a total of six days, but is also possible in seven days so that your body can acclimatize properly. We recommend this extra day as it increases your chances to reach the summit. In this case, you would take an extra day to hike from Barranco Camp to Barafu Camp and day five of this route will correspond with day five and six of the Lemosho route.
blocks.html: In total, climbing the Machame route takes six days, though you can also do it in seven to give your body time to acclimatise well. We advise adding this extra day, because it improves your chances of reaching the summit. You would then use the additional day to walk from Barranco Camp to Barafu Camp, and day five of this route would match days five and six of the Lemosho route.

blocks.orig: Your Tanzania Trip offers a unique service throughout the climb
blocks.html: Your Tanzania Trip gives you distinctive care for the entire climb

blocks.orig: Climbing Kilimanjaro is the ultimate challenge! Little details can make a world of difference, which is why with us, you climb with professional guides, porters, and a cook. They take care of you during your ascent via the Machame route, by checking your health twice a day and serving you delicious food. Sounds like a bit much? Not if you want to reach the top! Because we know that altitude sickness can creep up on you unnoticed and that proper nutrition* is essential to keep you going during a strenuous climb.
blocks.html: Climbing Kilimanjaro is the ultimate test! Small details can make a huge difference, so when you climb with us you are accompanied by professional guides, porters and a cook. On your way up the Machame route, they look after you, checking your health twice a day and preparing tasty meals. Does that seem excessive? Not if reaching the summit is your goal! We know that altitude sickness can develop without you noticing, and that good nutrition* is vital to keep your energy up on a tough climb.

blocks.orig: *If you would like to see the menu, we can send it in advance.
blocks.html: *We are happy to send you the menu beforehand if you would like to see it.

blocks.orig: If you like advice on how to prepare yourself for climbing Kilimanjaro, you can always contact us or read our blog How to prepare for climbing Kilimanjaro?
blocks.html: For tips on getting ready to climb Kilimanjaro, feel free to get in touch with us or have a look at our blog How to prepare for climbing Kilimanjaro?

blocks.orig: When you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there waiting for you. He then drops you off at your hotel, where you can relax from your flight.
blocks.html: On arrival at Kilimanjaro International Airport, your Your Tanzania Trip guide is already waiting. He takes you to your hotel so you can rest after the flight.

blocks.orig: Preparation for your climb: You meet your guide before the start of your climb, where he briefs you and offers advice on what to wear, what to pack, and other important tips to make your climb as comfortable as possible.
blocks.html: Getting ready for your climb: Before the climb starts you meet your guide for a briefing, with advice on clothing, packing and other useful tips to keep you as comfortable as possible on the mountain.

blocks.orig: The first morning, your guide picks you up from the hotel and takes you to Machame Gate. The first part leads you through coffee and banana plantations, as well as an untouched and very green rainforest. After a five to six-hour hike, you reach the Machame Camp on the edge of the forest area with a heather zone. This is your first day at this altitude, so remember to drink plenty of water!
blocks.html: On the first morning your guide collects you at the hotel and drives you to Machame Gate. To begin with, the trail winds through coffee and banana plantations and an unspoilt, lush green rainforest. After five to six hours of walking you arrive at Machame Camp, where the forest gives way to a heather zone. It is your first day at this height, so be sure to drink lots of water!

blocks.orig: This second day on the mountain starts with another nice climb that is a little steeper. You first pass to a small circular cliff known as the picnic rock where you are rewarded with stunning views of Kibo (a peak of Kilimanjaro) and Shira (one of the other volcanic peaks). From the picnic rock, you hike on to Shira Camp via a beautiful route to have lunch and rest. If you wish, you can take an acclimatisation walk towards the Lava Tower (to an altitude of 4630 meters and a distance of 2 km).
blocks.html: Your second day on the mountain begins with another pleasant climb, this time slightly steeper. First you reach a small round cliff called the picnic rock, where you are rewarded with superb views of Kibo (one of Kilimanjaro's peaks) and Shira (another of the volcanic peaks). From the picnic rock a lovely trail brings you to Shira Camp for lunch and a rest. If you like, you can go on an acclimatisation walk towards the Lava Tower (up to 4630 metres, over a distance of 2 km).

blocks.orig: From Shira Camp to the beautiful Lava Tower, you go through many ascents and descents with amazing views along the way. You have lunch at Lava Tower for one to two hours for your body to acclimatize as you might feel uncomfortable with the increase in altitude. After lunch, you descend to Barranco Camp. Watch out for strange-looking flowering plants that grow up to five meters high! Barranco Camp is located at the foot of the imposing Barranco Wall, which is impressive in both its sheer size and steepness.
blocks.html: The stretch from Shira Camp to the striking Lava Tower climbs and drops many times, with wonderful views throughout. Lunch at Lava Tower lasts one to two hours so your body can acclimatise, as the gain in height may make you feel unwell. After lunch you go down to Barranco Camp. Keep an eye out for unusual flowering plants that can reach five metres tall! Barranco Camp sits at the base of the towering Barranco Wall, remarkable for both its sheer size and how steep it is.

blocks.orig: After breakfast, you depart Barranco Camp and hike towards Barranco Wall. After a challenging but enjoyable route, you reach the top of the Barranco wall and have a spectacular view of the Kibo volcano to your left and of the distant Mount Meru to your right. Then a more difficult hike starts through Karanga Camp, with many ascents and descents, after which you reach your camp for the night: Barafu Camp, the last camp before the summit! Enjoy a hot meal and make sure to relax and sleep, before your final ascent to the summit!
blocks.html: Following breakfast you leave Barranco Camp and walk towards Barranco Wall. A demanding but fun climb brings you to the top of the Barranco wall, with a spectacular view of the Kibo volcano on your left and Mount Meru far off on your right. Next comes a tougher walk via Karanga Camp, full of ups and downs, before you arrive at tonight's camp: Barafu Camp, the final camp before the summit! Have a hot meal and be sure to rest and sleep before the last climb to the top!

blocks.orig: Today is the day! Around midnight you start from Barafu Camp to Uhuru Peak. The climb leads over good trails and the most challenging part is the high altitude. Once you reach the summit you can enjoy a beautiful sunrise, which is quite impressive at this height! After a small time at the top, where you celebrate your ultimate triumph you descend slowly to the scenic Millennium Camp.
blocks.html: This is the big day! At around midnight you set off from Barafu Camp towards Uhuru Peak. The paths are good, and the hardest part is the high altitude. At the summit you can watch a beautiful sunrise, which is truly impressive at this height! After a short stay on top to celebrate your great achievement, you slowly make your way down to the scenic Millennium Camp.

blocks.orig: The Millenium camp is located in a tropical rainforest. When you wake up today, you feel a sense of relief from the reduced altitude and satisfaction from reaching the summit. After breakfast you take an easy walk to the park exit.
blocks.html: The Millenium camp lies in a tropical rainforest. Waking up today, you feel relieved at the lower altitude and satisfied at having reached the summit. After breakfast an easy walk brings you to the park exit.

blocks.orig: Your driver then brings you back to the hotel for a well-deserved rest!
blocks.html: Your driver then takes you back to the hotel, where a well-earned rest awaits!

blocks.orig: Sadly, this is the end of your holiday and the time to go home has arrived. Enjoy your last hours in Tanzania before our driver comes to pick you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still longing for more? It's also possible to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
blocks.html: Unfortunately your holiday has come to an end and it is time to travel home. Make the most of your final hours in Tanzania until our driver collects you and brings you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight back. Want more? You can also combine your Kilimanjaro adventure with a few days of safari or a beach holiday!
